title: sources/<source>.yaml
description: One data source: its dialect, how to connect and which tables are in scope.

source.description: Source name. Equals the file name.

dialect.description: SQL dialect. Only duckdb and postgres run queries directly; the others use the query-plan protocol.

connection.description: How to connect. Never holds a URL or a secret.

env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the connection URL; never the URL itself.

database.description: DuckDB only: ":memory:" or a .duckdb file path relative to the semantic root.

setup.description: DuckDB only: statements run on every connection, in order. Each is one of an allowlist that sl validate checks and the DuckDB adapter enforces: LOAD or INSTALL of a named core extension, SET of a known safe setting, or CREATE SECRET from a provider chain or the environment, never literal keys.

views.description: DuckDB only: view name to relation, such as read_parquet('../data/x/*.parquet'). Each relation is a single table expression, a table function or a table name, with no subquery. Relative paths resolve from the semantic root.

intake.description: How the catalog reaches the layer and which schemas are read. Absent means mode connection with no schema limit.

mode.description: connection (the default when absent): the tools read the catalog through connection. export: the owner shared a catalog export because a connection was not possible.

reason.description: Export mode: why a connection was not possible, in the owner's words. sl validate warns when it is empty in export mode.

schemas.description: The only schemas read. A plain identifier; for BigQuery a dataset or project.dataset, for DuckDB an attached database's database.schema. sl validate errors on a duplicate and on a name that is not one, and warns on an empty list.

export.description: Export mode only: the catalog export the source was imported from.

file.description: Path of the export file, relative to the semantic root and inside it.

scope.description: Which tables are in scope. Exclude wins over include.

include.description: Patterns a table must match one of; empty or absent includes every table. Exact names and globs with * and ? (a dot matches schema.table, a "quoted" part matches exactly), or re:<regex> (at most 512 characters, checked for slow matching); see spec.md Scope patterns.

exclude.description: Patterns that remove a table from scope.

tables_file.description: A table-list file, relative to the semantic root (usually scope/<source>.txt): one pattern per line, !<pattern> to exclude, # comments. Its entries join include and exclude; see spec.md Table-list files.

sample_rows.description: Profile over a sample of this many rows when a table is larger; omit for full scans.

top_values.description: How many most frequent values to keep per column.

draft.description: Settings sl draft remembers for this source.

strip_prefixes.description: Prefixes removed from table names to form model names, such as fct_ and dim_.
